text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for customer SentinelAI on dedicated cluster eu-west-2-dedicated-7. Spike started ~12:03 UTC. Primary error signatures: gateway 502/504, internal 5xx, backend timeouts, and OOMs on a subset of GPU hosts. Paging @devon_oncall and SREs. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/ops/alerts/4645000000

devon_oncall: on it. digging into host list now. are we seeing noisy requests from tenant or host-side resource exhaustion?

ryan_sre: logs show repeated kernel OOM kills on gpu-node-7b and high NVML memory pressure on 7c. Also seeing continuous prefix eviction events on kv-cache for that tenant. grabbing more traces.

maria_eng: SentinelAI reported increased 5xx in their app last 5m. They said latency spikes that cause client retries. tagging @ella_cs to check customer impact / open channel.

ella_cs: on it — opened an email thread with SentinelAI support contact. They're seeing failed requests for model 'senti-large' and some jobs timing out. Impact: score API down for ~20% requests, customers on business tier affected. Will escalate if we can't mitigate in 15m.

devon_oncall: quick mitigation plan — 1) divert ingress for sentinel to fallback cluster eu-west-2-dedicated-4 (compatible model variant) 2) throttle large-batch jobs from their tenant 3) drain suspected OOM nodes 4) monitor errors. Who can flip routing?

lucas_sw: I can flip routing in the router service. Will run a dry-check first. command: `rtrctl reroute --tenant sentinelai --from eu-west-2-dedicated-7 --to eu-west-2-dedicated-4 --dry-run`

ryan_sre: posting recent kernel log snippet from gpu-node-7b: 
```
[12:02:51] oom_reaper: task model_server invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x24000c0
[12:02:51] Memory cgroup out of memory: Kill process 23456 (model_server) score 987
[12:03:12] nvml: memory error: reserved 0x40000000 > available 0x3f000000
```

maria_eng: looks like larger batches causing KV cache churn + GPU memory pressure. Could be large streaming decode jobs + high concurrency. Suggest enabling immediate per-tenant batch-size cap.

sam_prodsec: FYI SentinelAI recently increased concurrency in their prod rollout — noticed in billing logs. Might map. Recommend temporary limits.

devon_oncall: okay lucas, proceed with dry-run then route change if checks pass. lucas, post dry-run output. I'll prepare drain commands for nodes 7b/7c.

lucas_sw: dry-run output: compatible model variant found on target cluster (senti-large-v2-quant). Estimated additional latency +15ms, capacity headroom available. No incompat flags. Ready to apply. `rtrctl reroute --apply` when ready.

devon_oncall: applying reroute now. `rtrctl reroute --tenant sentinelai --from eu-west-2-dedicated-7 --to eu-west-2-dedicated-4 --apply`

incidents-bot: reroute job started (job id 7-464500A). Progress: 10%...50%...90%...done. Health checks ok for new routes.

ella_cs: telling SentinelAI support that we're routing traffic to a compatible fallback cluster. Requesting they pause any heavy batch experiments for 10m.

maria_eng: applying per-tenant batch cap: `configctl set tenant.sentinelai.batch_max_tokens 4096 --ephemeral 30m` applied. Also decreasing max_concurrency to 4 for that tenant.

sam_prodsec: noted. I'm tagging security but nothing suspicious beyond higher concurrency.

ryan_sre: starting node drain on gpu-node-7b: `kubeadm cordon gpu-node-7b && kubectl drain gpu-node-7b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will watch for eviction timeouts.

devon_oncall: monitoring error rate now. dashboards show 5xx tail dropping from 18% -> 6% in last 4m. Latency p50 stable, p95 improving.

incidents-bot: escalation timer: 15m remaining for customer SLA review. Alerts suppressed for reroute window to avoid noise.

lucas_sw: reroute confirmed stable. No additional capacity issues on eu-west-2-dedicated-4. Rolling restarts avoided.

ella_cs: SentinelAI confirms some requests now succeed, but some older sessions time out. They're asking for postmortem and whether committed data lost — clarifying.

maria_eng: we should also check KV eviction rate. `kvctl metrics --tenant sentinelai --window 10m` shows eviction_count=1200 (up from baseline 25). Eviction spikes correlate with bursts from a single API key.

devon_oncall: can we throttle that API key? If yes, do it. If not, block heavy requests.

lucas_sw: `ratelimitctl set key:sentinelai:heavy_job 30r/min --temporary 20m` applied.

sam_prodsec: adding note — rate-limit won't affect non-heavy endpoint keys.

ryan_sre: after drains and reroute, kernel OOMs stopped on remaining nodes. GPU memory usage normalized. No new OOM events in last 6m.

devon_oncall: good. current status: traffic diverted, batch caps + concurrency limits live, offending api key rate-limited, nodes drained for inspection. Customer impact reduced but some session retries needed. Next actions: 1) deeper postmortem for KV cache pressure 2) consider autoscale cushions for dedicated pools 3) follow up with SentinelAI on recommended client changes.

ella_cs: logged customer incident ticket and scheduled a 1:1 post-incident sync in 2h. Sent initial notes and asked them to hold off heavy experiments until we finish root cause.

maria_eng: opening an internal ticket: PID 78321 — investigating cache eviction policy + tenant isolation failure modes. Assigning to eng-runtime and infra.

devon_oncall: shifting to monitoring mode. I'll remain on-call for 30m to watch for regression. If stable after 30m, we'll close page and record incident.

incidents-bot: incident state changed -> mitigation in place. Severity set to sev2. Pages silenced.

lucas_sw: small note — target cluster used a quantized variant; quality checks passed but will include in postmortem to confirm output parity for their evaluation prompts.

ryan_sre: logs/archives saved: s3://incidents/4645000000/sentinelai-logs.tar.gz

devon_oncall: thanks all. summary for timeline — 12:03 alert, 12:05 routing dry-run, 12:07 apply reroute, 12:09 batch caps + rate-limits, 12:12 drains started, 12:16 errors down to baseline. Follow-ups: eng-runtime postmortem (PID 78321), capacity policy review, customer sync. Closing thread after 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
